reviews.text: Really cool game. Lots of content and emotions you'll get while playing. It's not quite perfect (indie), but Agapika has a soul. And I love it. Expect spending many hours getting all that Steam achievements!

i like the mix with with story quests,really gives you a purpose to do runs,tho im stuck right now on 1 mission and cant beat it,i wish there was some meta progression that even if you lost you can upgrade your heroes or weapons
Its sufficiently different to warrant a try.

Chop down tree to gather 2 branches? Catch glimpse of cyclops - with just one eye? Mix up absolutely everything, yet somehow still get job done? That is perfectly ordinary workday for hero of Ahapika!
Ahapika is a narrative-driven action-adventure game where you run a heroic agency in Ancient Greece, taking on unique, story-focused quests from ordinary mortals and whimsical Olympian gods.
Fun Demo, sounds could use a little work but overall I liked it!
The premise is amusing and the writing made me laugh.

Необычное приключение, где вы управляете агентством героев и отправляете их на задания. Подбирайте команду, развивайте персонажей и принимайте решения. Менеджмент, юмор и яркий мир отлично сочетаются.
Mighty bullet hell covered head to toe with impassioned Greek mythology! Not all mindless fun, vivacious narratives are also entangled. Oh, muscles galore, whew! Should've led with it. Total package~
hilarious and dynamic 'bullet novella' with a unique take on myths! Hordes of enemies, capricious gods, and heroic labors await. A fresh spin on ancient Greek legends!
Action roguelite about running a hero agency in Ancient Greece. 10 heroes, 17 story quests, endless arena. Very funny.
